purpose: Bounded visual QA of actual acquired export images; no acquisition, publication, asset deletion or final-catalog changes.

scope.explanation: All 171 frozen image assets were visually inspected. Item decisions use the current prepared items only when their payload/source-post relationship matches the reviewed bytes; no later unseen image is approved.

method: Nine original-derived contact sheets reviewed visually, five WebP originals viewed separately, and three ambiguous images inspected at original resolution. Source SHA256 checked before/after review. Selected original post context was read for ambiguous association only.

policy.originals: All acquired images/files are retained unchanged. Contact sheets are QA artifacts and must never replace source-image previews.
policy.eligibility: previewEligible describes visual suitability plus a known source-post association, not package correctness, official authorship, licensing or game compatibility.
policy.artwork: Hand-drawn and branded novelty artwork is not rejected solely for quality; it is explicitly classified and generally medium confidence. Editor/menu/desktop/phone screenshots and unrelated imagery remain ineligible.
policy.unsupported: Videos and XCF/source-project payloads are not decoded or approved as image previews. No payload code was executed, no network or app control was used.
